events.title: Student Leadership Conference
events.subtitle: UC Merced Conference Center
events.description: A full day of leadership development for UC Merced students, alumni, staff, faculty and guest speakers, built around workshops, connection, and confidence building. This year's conference theme is Resilient & Rising: Leading through Challenge & Change. This theme recognizes that resilience is not just about surviving college - it's about learning how to lead with intention, set boundaries, build community, and care for yourself along the way. Centering the experiences of first-generation students, this conference creates space to explore the realities of stress, pressure, self-doubt, and growth in ways that are honest, affirming, and empowering. Through interactive workshop sessions, meaningful dialogue, and community-centered learning, participants will: Develop sustainable approches to leadership and well-beingStrengthen their voice in academic and professional spacesExplore identity, culture, and community as sources of resilienceTranslate their lived experiences into leadership & career readinessStudents will choose a focused learning track that reflects their personal leadership journey - whether that's cultivating self-care, finding their voice, honoring their story, or preparing for life beyond college. At it's core, this conference sends a message to students: You are already resilient - and you deserve to rise in ways that support your whole self.
